evidence.claim: Olitalia ha sede a Forlì conta 130 dipendenti ed è presente in 100 paesi servendo ristoranti e chef.
evidence.quote: Olitalia is present in 100 countries around the world today. || Olitalia has its roots in the Emilia Romagna region, Italy’s culinary heartland, with headquarters in Forlì. Thanks to exponential growth, it now has 130 employees. || For restaurants and chefs Olitalia gives restaurant professionals the products they need to serve dishes that reflect their passion for good food and gastronomic culture.
